correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact coefficient formula, the proof derives the O_k(m^-2) normalized coefficient estimate using composite trapezoidal error for compactly supported continuous piecewise quadratic functions. Exact finite Fourier orthogonality gives the root-of-unity value. A complex quadratic blow-up and Rouché establish the residue-dependent first-order radial asymptotic with O_k(m^-2) error, and degree counting fixes all large-m interior roots. Critical formula identities passed 1,544 finite independent checks, which support but do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: The natural diagonal zero levels of rational Hartogs Bergman kernels are already the subject of structural zero-count results. Their sharp approach to the unit circle is a motivated invariant distinguishing stable interior zeros from boundary-condensing ones. The new universal fixed-gap coefficient identifies genuinely distinct arithmetic residue classes already in gap five; it extends beyond the known gap-three constant and is not a routine finite table.
